title: Compile provenance manifest (zic-rs-compile-manifest-v8)
description: Per-run build provenance: source inputs + hashes, build/source profiles, link profile, tzdb identity, zones/links touched, and the (typed) oracle result. Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
